parameters.completionTitle: Bank statement processed and saved to the database!

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "qwen2.5:3b",
  "prompt": "You are a bank transaction classifier. Analyse the description and return the correct category from this list: [Groceries, Restaurants, Transport, Health, Home, Entertainment, Services, Income, Shopping, Other].

Examples:
- 'POS PAYMENT SUPERMARKET ROSSI CARD N. 123' -> Groceries
- 'POS PAYMENT BAR CENTRALE CARD N. 456' -> Restaurants
- 'SEPA DIRECT DEBIT ENERGIA SPA' -> Home
- 'POS PAYMENT TRAIN TICKET' -> Transport

Transaction: '{{ $json.descrizione }}'
Reply with ONLY the single category word, no punctuation.",
  "options": {
    "temperature": 0
  },
  "stream": false
}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO transactions (
    transaction_hash,
    transaction_date,
    description,
    currency,
    amount,
    category
)
VALUES (
    md5($1 || '_' || $2 || '_' || $3 || '_' || $4 || '_' || $5),
    to_date($1, 'DD/MM/YYYY'),
    $3,
    $2,
    $4::numeric,
    $6
)
ON CONFLICT (transaction_hash) DO NOTHING;
